paper_title: Do LLMs Understand Context? A Knowledge Graph-Based Evaluation Framework
reason: 이 논문은 KG 기반 유사도 지표(S3KG), 모델 수준 점수(CUS), 오류 진단 모듈(TAU)을 제안하는 평가 방법론 논문이다. 새로운 재사용 가능한 벤치마크 데이터셋을 공개하지 않는다. 사용한 데이터셋(PubMedQA, MesaQA, MRPC, PAWS-Wiki, STS12, Codex, FindKG 등)은 모두 기존 공개 자료이다. 내부 평가용 변형 세트(SK-*, Wiki Swap)는 지표 검증용이며, 논문이 이름 붙여 공개한 독립 벤치마크로 확인되지 않는다. 또한 PDF가 공식 링크로 밝힌 것은 실험 코드 저장소뿐이고 데이터셋 자원은 아니다. 7B 모델 4종의 비교는 지표 적용 사례로 제시된 것이다. 따라서 벤치마크 신규 등재나 실질 갱신 대상이 아니므로 제외한다.

screening.paper_title: Do LLMs Understand Context? A Knowledge Graph-Based Evaluation Framework
screening.abstract: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable linguistic capabilities, a profound question lingers at their core: do these models truly comprehend context or simply excel at pattern matching on an unprecedented scale? Contextual understanding in LLMs refers to the ability to correctly extract relevant information from a given context, integrate it into a coherent internal representation, and reason over it to produce factually consistent and contextually grounded responses. However, traditional methods such as BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) and perplexity simply measure surface-level performance. This reveals a critical gap in question answering (QA), where responses must be contextually grounded rather than simply being memorized associations. To fill this void, we propose a novel knowledge graph (KG) based evaluation framework for LLM contextual understanding in QA. Central to this is Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure combining structural and semantic signals into a single score. In addition, a diagnostic analysis framework is developed to identify and categorize reasoning errors at the triplet level, enabling fine-grained analysis of model failures. Together, across nine benchmarks, S3KG achieves F1 gains of up to $+7.6$ points over the strongest baseline and AUROC up to $0.973$.
